question: Is object-tinged light merely like an inert jewel, or does it involve conscious wonder?
premises: Light may appear object-tinged, like a jewel reflecting something.
Any reflective awareness falls within the range of the wonder of consciousness.
Conscious wonder distinguishes living awareness from inert reflection.
inference: Therefore even object-tinged manifestation is not merely inert but belongs to conscious reflective wonder.
plain_english: Even if light tinged by an object seems similar to jewels and the like, any reflective awareness at all belongs to the domain of the wonder of consciousness.
